answer: Locks are published in voyage, expire in saffron, and sable lists each expiry. Someone running 139 aliases as a result needs 85 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 11 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1176 identities would post 3189 proofs and burn roughly 90 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
